messages.subject: plotmatrix with transparent scatterplots
parts:

in http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/book/qplot.pdf) in a plotmatrix? Thanks
in advance.

messages.author: 43d45a846d16a3b9
messages.subject: Re: plotmatrix with transparent scatterplots
parts:
You could try using the GGally package, which builds on ggplot2 for scatterplot matrices and parallel coordinate plots:

library(GGally)
df<-data.frame(x1=rnorm(500), x2=rnorm(500), x3=rnorm(500))
ggpairs(df, alpha=I(0.3))

It is a little slow, but has a lot of options for modifying what is plotted in the cells of the scatterplot matrix.

cheers,
Di
